The program20 November 2026 · Dubai
01Morning

The mastermind

We start the day at a private venue. The speakers all run businesses doing 7 to 8 figures, and they talk about what is working for them right now: growth, sales, offers, hiring. You can ask them questions too.

We will share the venue before the event.

02Afternoon

A private yacht

Then we go out on a yacht. It is only for founders who have already built something, so you are around people at your level.

We will share the yacht details before the event.

03Evening

A private dinner

In the evening there is a private dinner. We choose who comes. No stage, just real conversations, good food and a lot of laughs.

We will share the location before the event.

Tickets

Each ticket includes everything in the one before it. Places on the yacht and at the dinner are limited.

Questions

FAQ

Contact us
Who is this for?

Founders and business owners who want to learn from people who are further ahead, and meet others at a similar level.

What does the day look like?

It starts around 10:00 Dubai time on 20 November with the mastermind. Then the yacht in the afternoon, and the private dinner in the evening.

Where is it?

In Dubai. The exact locations of the venue, the yacht and the dinner are sent to ticket holders beforehand.

Who are the speakers?

Founders who run 7 and 8 figure businesses. You can see the ones we have announced so far in the speakers section, and more are coming.

What is included in each ticket?

General Admission is the mastermind, lunch, networking breaks and Q&As. VIP adds the yacht with other founders. VIP Pro adds the private dinner with selected guests.

How do I get a VIP Pro ticket?

VIP Pro is by application. Message us on Instagram and we will get back to you, usually within minutes.

Are flights and hotels included?

No. The tickets cover the event only, as listed on each ticket.

How do I pay?

General Admission and VIP go through a secure checkout on Whop. Prices are in euros, with the approximate amount in dirhams shown.
